name: workos
description: Health Web Group Work OS — the whole application, API and interface.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix api install
scripts.build: npm --prefix web install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix api install --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix api run typecheck && npm --prefix web exec tsc -- -b
scripts.deploy: cd api && npx --yes wrangler d1 migrations apply workos --remote && npx --yes wrangler deploy
